Skull and Bones is an open‑world naval action RPG where no one rules the sea. Ship combat, build choice, and sailing skill define your legend. Play solo or team up with two friends to conquer rival ships and mythical beasts in a vast ocean of up to 20 players.

Skull and Bones: Y3S2 First Look - The Deck Devstream
Captains, Year 3 Season 2 sets sail August 18.

Join us for an exclusive Y3S2 preview stream : new ship, new content, balancing changes, quality of life improvements, and what's next for Faction War. The dev team will walk you through it all and answer your questions.

About Skull and Bones:
Enter the perilous world of Skull and Bones, where you play by your own rules to rise from a nobody to become the most fearsome pirate kingpin. Craft a variety of unique ships, forge unlikely alliances, and take part in thrilling naval battles as you overcome the odds and bring mayhem on the seas. Be part of an immersive world that introduces new challenges and features every season.
